name: @w6w-apps/lemonsqueezy
description: Sell software and digital products through Lemon Squeezy — catalog, customers, orders and refunds, subscriptions, discounts, license keys, checkouts and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Lemon Squeezy is a merchant of record for software and digital products — it sells on your behalf and handles payment collection, sales tax/VAT and invoicing worldwide. This app manages the resulting catalog and customer lifecycle: products, variants and prices; customers; orders, their invoices and refunds; subscriptions, including plan changes, pausing and cancelling; discount codes; license keys generated for licensed products; custom checkout links; and webhook subscriptions for event delivery.

A cancelled subscription keeps running until its `ends_at` date even though its `status` flips immediately — a detail this app surfaces explicitly, since a workflow that treats cancellation as instant loss of access would be wrong. Orders cannot be created through this API (they are the result of a checkout being completed by a customer); this app reads and refunds them instead. License key activation/deactivation/validation uses a separate, unauthenticated License API meant for the licensed software itself to call, not the store owner's API key, and is out of scope here — see the README.
